checks.step3_heading: Connect Wallet Up to your site
step3_preselected_methods:
Add payment to a form or store
· Change
step3_woo_copy: On the free plan, Wallet Up does not add payment options to the WooCommerce checkout or to WPForms. You can place a Cash App, Venmo or PayPal QR code or link on any page with a block or shortcode. Checkout and form placement are part of Pro.See Pro
Connect Stripe once to take cards at your WooCommerce checkout, paid to your own Stripe account.
Show PayPal at my WooCommerce checkoutPRO

Showing PayPal as a WooCommerce checkout option is part of Pro and is not included in the free plan. On the free plan you can still share your PayPal link or QR on any page with a Wallet Up block, and connect Stripe above if you want cards at checkout.
